title: The geography of Chern slopes with prescribed fundamental group
summary: Let $G$ be the topological fundamental group of a nonsingular complex projective surface. Troncoso and Urzúa proved that the Chern slopes $c_1^2/c_2$ of minimal surfaces of general type $S$ with $π_1(S)\simeq G$ are dense in $[1,3]$, and left $[1/3,1)$ open. We prove that they are dense in $[1/2,3]$, an interval that cannot be enlarged without contradicting either a theorem of Mendes Lopes and Pardini or Reid's conjecture.
